description: The bar chart compares the self-report accuracy of GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models before and after introspection training. The vertical axis represents the self-report accuracy, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini. There are three sets of bars for each model, representing the control condition, before introspection training, and after introspection training. The control condition is shown in grey, before introspection training in light blue, and after introspection training in dark blue. For GPT-4o, the accuracy increases from approximately 0.25 in the control condition to about 0.75 after introspection training. For GPT-4o-mini, the accuracy also increases from around 0.25 in the control condition to approximately 0.75 after introspection training. Error bars are present on each bar, indicating variability in the measurements.
